impact: 10 failures with 'Call to undefined method PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase::skip()'. The files are class-based PHPUnit tests using Pest's skip helper. Mechanical: markTestSkipped() is the class-based equivalent.
resolution: Fixed: 10 test()->skip() calls in AdvancedTaskExampleTest became $this->markTestSkipped(). Inside a body test() is the PHPUnit TestCase, which has no skip(), so the intended skips were being counted as failures. The declaration-level })->skip() used elsewhere is correct and untouched.
title: TaskRunner tests call $this->skip(), which is Pest-only, from PHPUnit classes
